title: brightness keys and the keyboard light key

clauses.text: the brightness keys change the panel in small even steps and never go fully dark

steps.do: Press the brightness-down key until it stops, then press brightness-up.
steps.expect: Each press is one visible step, and the screen never goes black at the bottom.

clauses.text: the keyboard light key turns the light off and on again, and the toggle remembers

steps.do: On a keyboard with a keyboard light, press the keyboard light key, then press it again.
steps.expect: The keyboard light goes off on the first press and comes on again on the second.

clauses.text: a display with no brightness control says so instead of dimming in software

steps.do: On the Mac mini, with the external monitor only, press the brightness keys.
steps.expect: The message 'No brightness control on this display' is shown and the picture is not dimmed.
